title: What the site's onboarding offers a signed-in person
description: GET /api/v1/onboarding/site for any signed-in person: the repository mode, the integration steps in route order and the AI offer. It never carries the site's default repositories, their names or their number. A person who has signed in for the first time since the configuration existed gets the mode of that sign-in, and in auto and skip mode the names the site fetches for them: only defaults the gateway's check found they can read, never the rest.

imports.description: This person's own plan from the sign-in in which their account was created: the defaults the site fetches for them (auto, skip). Absent otherwise.
